Graduation 2027

May 21, 2027 at 5:00 PM CT Weiss Field

Commencement for the Waukegan High School Class of 2027. Friday, May 21, 2027 at 5:00 PM CT at Weiss Field.

Rehearsal is May 19 at 10:00 AM at Brookside Campus.

Questions we get

When is graduation?+

Friday, May 21, 2027 at 5:00 PM CT.

Where is the ceremony?+

The 2027 ceremony is scheduled at Weiss Field.

Source: whs.wps60.org ↗
